sentences.en: She didn't have time to go out with him, in other words, she rejected his invitation.
sentences.zh: 她没时间跟他出去，换句话说就是拒绝了他的邀请。

sentences.en: You need a lot of money for this trip, in other words, it's expensive.
sentences.zh: 你得带很多钱去这次旅行，换句话说就是很贵。

sentences.en: He didn't pass the exam, in other words, he failed.
sentences.zh: 他没通过考试，换句话说就是不及格了。
